newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TOLARAM LOOKS AT SCIENCE/TECH PARK - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: TOLARAM LOOKS AT SCIENCE/TECH PARK - REPORT.

text.p: Tolaram Investments, a subsidiary of Singaporean Tolaram group, is seeking to purchase the former Tsarist-era army barracks in Tallinn to establish a science and technology park, Aripaev said on Tuesday.
Urmas Reimand, director of Tolaram Invesments, said that a proposal to Tolaram to introduce the idea was made by the local government authority, the business daily said.
The total project could require as much as 100 million kroons, Reimand added.
The Tolaram group in Estonia owns several textile-related plants and a paper mill as well as a business centre.
